description: This file provides platform-specific upgrade functions for Mikrotik devices within the OpenWrt project. It includes functions to check images, perform NAND upgrades, and handle certain device models during the upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Simple image check function that always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs a NAND upgrade on Mikrotik devices, extracting the kernel from the firmware tarball and writing it to the appropriate MTD partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handler that selects device-specific upgrade procedures based on the device board name.
